https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: The Six Shirts Every Man Should Own
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: A solid collection of shirts is the cornerstone of any decent wardrobe. Even as menswear has skewed extra-casual over the past decade, the shirt has remained one of the few constants. Not only as the foundation of any formal dress code, but also as a reliable staple that’s easy to wear in any number of contexts across the smart-casual spectrum. Layered over a T-shirt or worn with a suit or jeans, there’s perhaps no item you’ll get more mileage out of. Of course, they come in all stripes – including striped. Here, the definitive list of the six shirt types that earn their place.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/l.title: 13 Lifestyle Tips To Take From The Italians
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/l.teaser: When it comes to the art of living beautifully, no nation has mastered it quite so well as the Italians. In the bel paese, revelling in life’s simple pleasures – be it a leisurely evening stroll with friends or beautifully cut blazer – is part of the national identity. This wonderful lust for life is something that we at MR PORTER are keen to embrace during these languorous summer months (and beyond). And as it turns out, there’s no need to hop over to the Amalfi Coast to do so (although, you can). Here, a few of our favourite Italians – and expats – have shared their secrets to bringing a touch of the dolce vita to the everyday.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: How To Build The Perfect Capsule Wardrobe
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: By now, you’re probably familiar with the concept of a capsule wardrobe – a selection of versatile, timeless and interchangeable staples in complementary colourways that can be styled with one another with little effort, to cater a variety of occasions and dress codes. The idea of this rigorously curated, fit-anywhere closet defies trends and seasons, ensuring it never goes out of style. But what are the essentials that no capsule can be without? And what if we told you that if those staples you pick to be part of it are made by some of the best in the business, using the best materials and are also able to stand the test of time? Just see for yourself below.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Perhaps you’ve heard the legend of Solomeo, the 14th-century Umbrian citadel that has been painstakingly resurrected by Brunello Cucinelli. But have you actually been there? Well, a select group of MR PORTER customers have now ticked off this bucket-list experience.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: Why The Polo Is This Summer’s Unsung Wardrobe Staple
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Not so long ago, we were singing the praises of the quarter-zip sweater and how it came to be “the MVP of your wardrobe”, thanks to how easy it is to wear and its ability to bridge the gap between smart and casual. Now a not-so-distant relation has entered the chat as its summer counterpart: the polo shirt. If you’ve stepped outside recently – or simply spent time scrolling through social media or watching live sport – then you’ll have noticed it everywhere, too.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: 13 French Menswear Brands You Should Know
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: French fashion has never been just one thing. It’s a colourful ecosystem built on contrast – SAINT LAURENT’s precision sitting alongside Jacquemus’s playfulness, CELINE’s cool against LEMAIRE’s restraint and Husbands’ nostalgic flair. Below, we spotlight the labels that built French style, from the most storied houses to ateliers still doing things the old way and newer brands setting the pace.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: How To Find The Perfect T-Shirt
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: The search for the perfect T-shirt goes back longer than you think. The tee first came into play in the late 1800s, when the US Navy began issuing them as standard undershirts. The name is down to F Scott Fitzgerald, who coined “T-shirt” in his 1920 debut novel This Side Of Paradise. It wasn’t long before, as with many military products, it made its way into the wardrobes of men not destined for the shores of enemy frontiers.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: The Style Debate: Standing Out Or Blending In
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Some of us just want to get noticed. And the way we dress is one of the easiest ways to achieve this. Why raise your voice over everyone else when your clothes can do it for you? Meanwhile, others are happy to keep their heads down. What they wear tends to whisper rather than shout. But pay attention and their subtler style choices shine through.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: Your Last-Minute Vacation Packing Guide
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Summer vacations take many forms – and so do the suitcases you pack for them. But when you end up booking the trip with just a few days to spare, throwing everything you have into a bag the night before just won’t work. Coastal breaks demand something different to mountain hikes – and they may even call for some specialist shopping. City escapes call for an entirely different wardrobe. Three things remain non-negotiable for most– shorts, sunglasses, SPF.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: The Biggest Sneaker Trends Of The Year
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: The fashion cycles of the running shoe can be hard to keep up with. One minute you’re on the front foot, wearing the sneaker that’s about to take off. The next, the whole world has moved on and you’re left sporting yesterday’s shoe. It’s an effort just staying on the treadmill. Perhaps the biggest change in recent times is that it’s not always the names you expect that you’re seeing on fashion-forward feet. All of a sudden, technical kit from the likes of Hoka, Satisfy and On is a big part of the conversation

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: A Day At The Beach With Orlebar Brown
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Last week, we celebrated summer with our friends at Orlebar Brown and special guests at El Chiringuito Ibiza, the beachside restaurant and event space in Ibiza. And it got us thinking. About lazy days spent lounging by bodies of water. Which, rather appropriately, is where Orlebar Brown itself first began… In February 2005, Adam Brown was sat by a hotel pool in Rajasthan. He noticed that all the women looked great in their array of swimming costumes. The men, well, less so.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: Three Ways To Wear White Jeans
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: White jeans have somewhat of an undeserved reputation. They’re often written off as summer wear, worn in the in-between months and forgotten about by September – which is a shame, because they can be one of the most useful things you can own. Dress them up and they’ll do a business dinner. Pair them with a chore jacket, or another denim piece, and they’re weekend-proof. The trick is knowing they’re not just a one-season item – they’re a blank canvas that just happens to be trousers. Below are three ways to make them work for you.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/l.title: Three Summer Cocktail Recipes From Our Favourite Bars
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/l.teaser: Summer entertaining doesn’t ask for much. Nobody expects a five-course meal when it’s 28ºC outside. What most do expect, though, is something fun, iced and in their hand within about one minute of arriving. Get that part right and you’re in the clear for whatever comes next – be it bites in the garden or something more ambitious. With that in mind, we asked three of our favourite bars for the drinks they’d make if they were the ones hosting. The results are bright, refreshing and built for repetition.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: How To Dress For A Wedding As A Groom Or Guest
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Weddings have a way of forcing men to reckon with their wardrobes. In a world where dress codes have steadily relaxed, formalwear has become the exception rather than the rule. And yet, certain occasions still demand it: weddings, funerals and – God forbid – court appearances. The problem is, as suits have receded from daily life, so has the knowledge of how to wear one. In my years writing about menswear, I’ve seen a recurring drama unfold: men who delay, who misjudge, who seek out tailors too late. The suit is too tight or too loose.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: From Sunset Boulevard to Skyfall, swimming pools have often served as the backdrop to some of cinema’s most pivotal scenes. But also the most stylish? As James Bond’s standard issue Orlebar Browns show, the right swimwear can really make a splash. Here are the movies in which the pool takes a leading role. Romance with an older woman, romance with her daughter and a comedy wetsuit. It wouldn’t be summer without watching Dustin Hoffman’s Benjamin Braddock in that ill-advised outfit – an unwanted present from his folks, who push him into the family pool on his 21st birthday.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.title: The Stealth Italian Brands That Will Make You Look Your Best
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Italians like to talk. To each other, to anyone, anywhere. We commend them for this. But they also know when to keep schtum. They can famously hold entire conversations using their hands instead of their mouths. And, based on the evidence put forward on the shelves of MR PORTER, they can also use restraint in the way they communicate with their clothes.

https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/l.teaser: If you’re reading this, then you’re undoubtedly a man – or a woman – of the world. However, the smartest men – or women – also know that they know nothing, to paraphrase a long-dead Greek philosopher. And herein lies the point.

It’s a sport that pairs the gladiatorial with the graceful, which is always going to appeal to the high-end marks in Switzerland and beyond, with brands clamouring to get their latest on the wrists of the world’s best.
